formative_worksheets.title: The Combo Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (10 min).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming combo creation before $100.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can make amounts in different ways.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can make amounts in different ways.
header.character_watermark: Tappy the Frog with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.visual_layout: Two blank workspaces with one dollar labels.

image_placeholders.description: Two blank workspaces for Grade 2 formative check, B&W line art. Each labelled '$1 =' for coin combos.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_DOLLAR at Prompt 1: keywords name the dollar combo ways task.

prompts.prompt: Show 1 way to make thirty-five dollars ($35).
prompts.visual_layout: A blank thirty-five dollar workspace with $35 label.

image_placeholders.description: A blank thirty-five dollar workspace for Grade 2 formative check, B&W line art. Labelled '$35 =' for bills and coins combo.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_35 at Prompt 2: keywords name the thirty-five combo task.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 2 formative check, B&W line art.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child.
